periods.label: 钢铁狂熊的怪力与农家气质

status.current: appears at the banquet and casually eats Tatara's poisoned bladed chicken

relationships.yui-tatara: Neutralizes her poison intimidation by eating the trapped chicken without harm.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: One of the national-class rivals at the banquet.

periods.summary: Kaga is a huge Hokkaido representative and former top-eight fighter. When Tatara's poisoned chicken is exposed, he picks it up and eats the meat, bones and razor blades together, declaring that her poison might kill an elephant but not him. His appearance emphasizes the depth of national-level competitors surrounding Ikki.

key_events.summary: Eats the poisoned bladed chicken that Tatara had prepared.

abilities: extreme toughness and digestion / resistance to poison and blades
